fusions.name: Herd's Circle
fusions.desc: Sweeps the blade around you, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. Its damage rises 10% for each ally near you (max 40%).

fusions.name: Pick the Straggler
fusions.desc: A reaching thrust at an enemy up to 6 tiles away that deals 14 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach, and stuns it for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Shoulder to Shoulder
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

fusions.name: Graze Between Bouts
fusions.desc: Each time you kill something, you restore 3 stamina a second for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
